All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractGraph
Base class providing behaviour shared by all graph representations: equality, hashing, string output, file input, and a pluggable topological sort strategy.
AdjacencyListGraph
Graph stored as an adjacency list with weights: for each vertex a map from neighbor to edge weight.
AdjacencyMatrixGraph
Graph stored as an adjacency matrix with weights: for each vertex, a map from neighbor to edge weight.
DfsTopologicalSort
Topological sort via depth-first search.
Edge
A weighted directed edge.
Graph
A directed weighted graph with string-labeled vertices.
IncidenceMatrixGraph
Graph stored as an incidence matrix: rows are vertices, columns are edges.
TopologicalSort
Strategy for ordering graph vertices so that every edge goes from an earlier vertex to a later one.
